# Alba Residences

> The Alba Residences is an ultra-luxury beachfront development on the Crescent of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, comprising three low-rise buildings of nine and ten storeys set within roughly 26,000 square metres of landscaped grounds. It offers 88 simplex and duplex homes together with penthouses, and day-to-day services are managed by the Dorchester Collection. Amenities include a private beach, a wellness centre of about 3,000 square metres and beachfront dining. Completion is expected in 2028.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2028

## MENASCO Scope

The Alba Residences is an ultra-luxury beachfront development by OMNIYAT on Palm Jumeirah, designed by Zaha Hadid Architects with landscape design by Vladimir Djurovic and managed by Dorchester Collection. Conceived around the themes of water and light, the scheme offers 88 simplex, duplex and super-penthouse residences. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the development.
